title: Cow Dung Manure Readiness Scanner
problem: Abba puts raw wet cow dung directly on young vegetable plants. It attracts harmful grubs that eat away the plant roots.
idea: A manure checker. Show the manure to the camera and it says if it is ready for the field or needs more time. Tap what the camera sees to try it.

widgets.heading: 🎯 Try it: Is the manure ready?
widgets.intro: In my real project, Teachable Machine looks at photos of the manure pit. Tap what the camera sees.
widgets.question: The camera sees this manure:

options.label: Dark, crumbly, earthy smell
options.result: READY! This manure is fully rotted. You can put it on the plants.

options.label: Half-dry, some lumps
options.result: Almost ready. Mix it and wait 2 or 3 more weeks.

options.label: Fresh, wet, smelly dung
options.result: NOT READY! Raw dung attracts grubs and burns young roots. Put it in the pit.
options.te: సిద్ధం కాలేదు! పచ్చి పేడ వేర్లకు హాని చేస్తుంది. గుంతలో వేయండి.

widgets.heading: ✅ Manure ready test
widgets.intro: Check the manure with Abba and tick what is true.

items.text: Colour is dark brown or black
It smells like soil, not bad
items.te: మట్టి వాసన వస్తోంది, చెడు వాసన లేదు

items.text: It breaks into small crumbs in the hand
It has rested in the pit for about 3 months or more

bands.text: Fully ready! Use it for your vegetables. 🌱
Nearly ready. Wait a few more weeks.
Not ready. Keep it in the pit and turn it sometimes.

how: Take photos of manure in your village: fresh dung, half-rotted and fully ready.
In Teachable Machine (Image Project), make 3 classes and upload about 40 photos each.
Train the model and Export the link.
In PictoBlox, add the Machine Learning extension and paste the link.
Show a green 'READY' message or a red 'WAIT' message for each class.
Ask Gemini how farmers can make good manure faster, and share the tips with Abba.
prompt: I am a Class 8 student from a farming family. Explain in simple English and Telugu why raw cow dung should not be put on young vegetable plants, and how to tell when farmyard manure is fully ready.
